01_s0: The wolf looks shocked, holding his head with both hands, in front of a giant screen with a red crypto price chart crashing down, red arrows pointing down, neon city at night.
01_s1: The wolf sits at a kitchen table and splits his money: a small pile of gold coins pushed forward to invest, while a big closed steel safe with a house icon and a shopping cart icon on its door stays locked next to him. Cozy apartment, warm evening light.
01_s2: The wolf rides a roller coaster whose track is shaped like a red crypto price chart, plunging down a very steep drop, fur blown back, screaming, neon city at night behind.
01_s3: The wolf lies awake in bed at night in pajamas but still wearing his gold Bitcoin chain, eyes wide open with dark circles, staring at a smartphone that glows red with a falling chart, dark bedroom, moonlight through the window.
01_s4: The wolf stands confidently with arms crossed between two giant monuments: a huge shiny golden Bitcoin coin on the left and a huge silver-blue Ethereum coin on the right, futuristic plaza, dramatic spotlights, low angle.
01_s5: The wolf raises one paw in a firm stop gesture in front of a shady street vendor stall full of weird cartoon meme coins with clown faces and rocket stickers, some of the coins are on fire, dark alley with neon signs.
01_s6: The wolf calmly drops one gold coin into a big glass jar that is already half full of gold coins, a wall calendar with weeks circled behind him, tidy office, soft morning light.
01_s7: The wolf relaxes in a leather armchair wearing sunglasses and sipping a coffee, in front of a big screen showing a steady green crypto chart rising slowly, calm and confident mood, modern office.
01_s8: Close-up of the wolf pointing directly at the viewer with a confident grin, neon crypto city background with floating gold coins, dynamic angle.
00_desk: The wolf sits at a desk in front of huge glowing trading screens with green crypto charts going up, neon blue cyber city at night.
